design.status: Frozen before implementation and before computing new estimator scores; selected inputs were previously inspected for integrity and selected after the historical audit.
design.estimand: Descriptive fixed-support angular recurrence across adjacent saved density meshes; not rescaled relic retention or causal memory.
design.radial_groups: exact squared radius using integer coordinates 2*i-31; uniform cell-volume weights
design.rotation_group: all 24 determinant-positive signed axis permutations including identity
limits: Real HALO fields are not assumed rotation-exchangeable; orientation ranks on them are diagnostics, not inferential p-values.
Fixture null-rate intervals describe independently generated analytical trials in each fixed envelope/family stratum, not physical epochs.
The original compact relic map does not sample the cavity-wall support; this different estimand does not repair that causal claim.
Raw inputs and preservation manifest remain local-only.
A static anisotropic field can show recurrence; this control must be explicitly reported.

recorded_runs.interpretation: Exploratory angular recurrence only; adjacent epochs are dependent and ranks are not physical p-values.
